name: vlms-bench
description: A benchmark collection for evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) on a variety of multimodal tasks such as visual question answering and image-grounded reasoning. It aggregates diverse VLM test items to probe image understanding, cross-modal reasoning, and instruction-following in multimodal contexts.
evaluation_method: accuracy (per-task accuracy for classification-style items; may include other task-specific metrics)
reputation: A smaller community dataset on Hugging Face for VLM evaluation with limited adoption compared to major VQA or multimodal leaderboards.
